minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  November 20, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on November 20, 2024.
Commissioner Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m., followed by the flag salute.

Irina Martirosian announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner
  Phyllis Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner Vicki Perryman- Banks -
  District 4, Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large.

  Absent: Commissioner Olivia Alvitre – District 2

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Harjinder Singh  Deputy City Manager
  Kerri Arroyo  Acting Library Director
  Irina Martirosian  Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. Hellen Lessick commented on the budget update and advised that a
quarterly invoice for Stewart Allen, website designer, in the amount of $525.00 is pending
payment.

MINUTES. It was moved by Commissioner Lesure and seconded by Commissioner Battle
that the minutes for the Arts Commission meeting held on August 21, 2024, be approved.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Battle, and Lesure
Abstain: Perryman-Banks

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
The Deputy City Manager reported on the following:
  a. The current Budget
  b. RFP for a consultant
  c. Public Art Fund Balance
  d. RLA conservation LLC
  e. Arts Commission moving forward with the library

  1
   Arts Commission

The Creative House Gallery – discussed the maintenance and cost associated of 16
Utility Boxes.

Commissioner Perryman-Banks made a motion to exept the Restoration of the History
of Transportation and Incomplete Conch Shell Art Conservation and Commisioner
Metcalf seconded.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Battle, Perryman-Banks, and Lesure
Noes: None

Commissioner Perryman-Banks made a motion to table the Creative House Discussion of
Utility Box maintenance to the next meeting, January 15, 2025, and Commissioner
Battle seconded.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Battle, Perryman-Banks, and Lesure
Noes: None

PUBLIC REMARKS. Helen Lessick provided a brief description of her book “Experiments
in Public Art by Inglewood Artists” and requested placement on the January agenda to
give a full presentation and seek funding.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
Commissioner Perryman-Banks moved to cancel the December meeting and hold the
Next Arts Commission Meeting on January 15th, 2025. Commissioner Metcalf seconded.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Battle, Perryman-Banks, and Lesure
Noes: None

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Lesure declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:02 p.m.
